tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Experience reliable business communication with the SNOM D305 4-SIP PoE Desk Black IP Phone Set (without adapter). Designed for professional office environments, this advanced IP phone combines durability, crystal-clear HD audio, and a 3.2" high-resolution graphical display (300 x 100 pixels) for smooth call management. Supporting up to 4 SIP accounts and Power over Ethernet (PoE), the SNOM D305 is an excellent choice for call centers, enterprises, and organizations in Bangladesh that demand stable and secure VoIP performance.


Its ergonomic design, intuitive function keys, and premium build quality ensure long-term usage without compromising comfort or efficiency. Whether for everyday office communication or high-demand call center operations, the SNOM D305 delivers performance you can trust.


Key Specifications

  • Model: SNOM D305
  • Display: 3.2" High-resolution graphical display, 300 × 100 pixels
  • SIP Support: Up to 4 SIP identities/accounts
  • Audio Quality: Wideband HD audio for superior clarity
  • Connectivity: Ethernet 10/100 Mbps, PoE supported
  • Keys & Controls: 4 context-sensitive keys, 5 configurable function keys
  • Design: Sleek ergonomic black desk phone with adjustable stand
  • Power: PoE powered (external adapter not included)
  • Ideal For: Call centers, offices, enterprises, and professional VoIP solutions
